prompt: Generate a step by step guide to find a job as a new cs grad.
response: 1. Start by updating your resume to include all relevant coursework, projects, and any internships or work experience. Tailor your resume for each job application, highlighting skills and experiences that match the job description. Use action verbs and quantify your achievements when possible. 2. Leverage your university's career services for resume reviews, interview preparation, and job leads. Attend career fairs and networking events to connect with potential employers. 3. Utilize online job boards and company websites to search for entry-level positions. Apply to positions that align with your skills and interests, and ensure you submit a tailored resume and cover letter. 4. Prepare for technical interviews by practicing coding problems and system design questions. Review common interview questions and prepare examples of your problem-solving skills. 5. Follow up after interviews with a thank-you email, and use this opportunity to reiterate your interest in the position and highlight any additional qualifications. 6. Be open to starting with internships or less glamorous positions, as these can provide valuable experience and lead to full-time opportunities.
